argv:
rc=0
for p in 15432 18083 18093; do
  if lsof -nP -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "PORT $p HELD:"; lsof -nP -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN; rc=1; else echo "port $p free"; fi
done
pgrep -fl "mc-walkthrough" || echo "no walkthrough processes"
(lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -E "18083|18093|15432") || echo "no listener rows"
rtk docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" | grep mc-walkthrough || echo "no mc-walkthrough container"
exit $rc
sanitize: DSN/password URLs scrubbed in .final copies; secret VALUES never captured in argv; env file never copied
